notes:
ACCESS: robots.txt at https://www.casaviva.es/robots.txt fetched FIRST via probe.fetch (200, 517 bytes). It has a single group, 'User-agent: *'. NO group names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai or Claude-Web, and there is no Content-Signal line, so there is no robots exclusion. That group disallows /on/demandware.store/*, /sitecore/, /layouts/, /service/, /views/, /api/, the facet/sort query forms (*prefn1=*, *prefv1=*, *pmax=*, *pmin=*, *q=*, *srule=*), /account*, /cart*, /checkout*, /search*, /wishlist* and /order-history. Every URL recorded here is a bare category path with no query string; no facet URL, no /search, no /api and no /on/demandware.store/ endpoint was requested. No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2s per-host pacing was used. All pages 200 on rotating curl_cffi fingerprints. TREE: taken from the site's OWN header mega-menu, which Casa Viva (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) server-renders as nested
    lists. The top-level item is 'Baño', whose dropdown gives Textil de baño (-> Toallas, Alfombras de baño), Complementos de baño (-> Espejos de baño, Cubos de baño, Básculas, Accesorios para colgar), Carros de baño and Organizadores de baño. That menu tree was then reconciled against the site's own category sitemap https://www.casaviva.es/sitemap_1-category.xml (reached from the Sitemap: line in robots.txt, 508 category URLs), which surfaced four further real nodes the dropdown omits: /bano/accesorios-de-bano/ with children dosificadores-y-jaboneros, escobilleros and portacepillos, plus /bano/organizadores-de-bano/cajas/, /bano/organizadores-de-bano/organizadores-de-maquillaje/ and /bano/textil-de-bano/cortinas-de-ducha/. Accesorios de baño is a genuine node, not a guess: it is linked from the home page body, it is in the category sitemap, its own breadcrumb reads Home > Baño > Accesorios de baño, and it carries 9 products. Every recorded URL came from the menu or that sitemap - none was pattern-guessed. QTY: each PLP renders its own exact total in the SFCC result-count element, '
    N Resultados
    '. The attribute and the visible text agree on every page, and on every page the number of distinct data-pid product tiles actually delivered in the HTML equals it exactly (33, 16, 14, 9, 8, 5, 3, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1) - i.e. the whole catalogue is small enough that every count was verified by enumeration to exhaustion, not by trusting a header. VERIFICATION: the tree partitions arithmetically, which is the strongest available check that each count belongs to the node requested: Baño 33 = Textil de baño 16 + Complementos de baño 5 + Accesorios de baño 9 + Carros de baño 3 + Organizadores de baño 0; Textil de baño 16 = Toallas 14 + Alfombras 2 + Cortinas de ducha 0; Complementos de baño 5 = Espejos 2 + Cubos 1 + Básculas 1 + Accesorios para colgar 1; Accesorios de baño 9 = Dosificadores 8 + Escobilleros 1 + Portacepillos 0. Those identities were used only as a cross-check - no quantity here is a sum, a parent's number reused, or an estimate. Counts discriminate (33/16/14/9/8/5/3/2/1/0), and every page's h1 and breadcrumb tail matched the node requested (e.g. /bano/complementos-de-bano/espejos/ -> h1 'Espejos de baño', breadcrumb Home > Baño > Complementos de baño). DEDUP: already_extracted() run on all sixteen candidate URLs. Exactly one hit - /bano/carros-de-bano/ -> Furniture.xlsx 'Bathroom Trolleys & Units' - moved to review[], not rows[]. The index holds 22 casaviva.es URLs in total, all from Furniture.xlsx and all outside the Baño tree except that one; Casa Viva does not appear in Final.xlsx at all. Every URL in rows[] returned None. EXCLUDED: /bano/ itself (33) and /bano/complementos-de-bano/ (5) and /bano/accesorios-de-bano/ (9) all have valid child listings, so they are grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rule 24). Five nodes are live in the nav or sitemap but render an empty product grid - Organizadores de baño and its two children, Portacepillos, and Cortinas de ducha - and are in review[] as EMPTY NODE rather than as zero-qty rows. Promotional and seasonal slugs (/rebajas/rebajas-bano/ and its three children, /summer-market-bano* x3, /basicos-para-el-bano/, /espejos-black-friday/) were not recorded per rule 25. The 'Ver todo Baño' / 'Ver todo Textil de baño' / 'Ver todo Complementos de baño' entries in the dropdown are View All links pointing at the parent URLs and were likewise not recorded (rule 25). Route-outs (Textil de baño and its three children -> Textile) and the general Salón > Espejos decorative-mirror node are in review[] so nothing is silently skipped. Casa Viva sells no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures or taps - the Baño tree above is the complete bathroom offer.
